label: Drink
description: Named cocktails, coffees, teas, wines, beers, spirits, juices, and other beverages.
notes: Prepared and pourable beverages belong here; food.dish holds meals and food.dessert holds spoonable sweets and frozen desserts. Values use familiar drink names that follow “a drink of,” and visual glosses give the usual color, vessel, foam, ice, and garnish. Kind chips classify drink families rather than serving temperature; standard presentations help distinguish similar liquids. Branded cocktail names are phrased generically, and beer and wine entries emphasize visibly different styles rather than production regions.
